question: Should OpenClaw adopt this fixed 512-row metadata-only gateway restart ledger as a permanent shared-state and privacy contract?
rationale: Tests can prove implementation safety, but they cannot decide which operational identifiers may be retained durably, how long they should remain, or whether operators need a supported query/export surface.

options.title: Approve the bounded ledger
options.body: Accept the metadata-only shared-SQLite design and fixed retention, with a short documented operator inspection and privacy contract before merge.

options.title: Narrow durable metadata
options.body: Retain restart source and normalized outcome fields but remove or further reduce actor, device, client-IP, changed-path, session, and task identifiers before merge.

options.title: Keep attribution ephemeral
options.body: Decline the permanent table and keep restart attribution in existing diagnostics or another explicitly approved observability surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded ledger
recommendation.body: Accept the metadata-only shared-SQLite design and fixed retention, with a short documented operator inspection and privacy contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the related metadata-only audit direction and explicitly identified gateway restart records as a separate candidate requiring its own decision.
